department: Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences

deadline.value: April 15 online submission deadline for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: The online submission deadline is when the initial application must be submitted online, provided the department has no earlier deadline. By the file completion deadline, admission must be granted and all documents required to obtain a student visa must be submitted to the Division of Global Engagement.

gre_general.value: General GRE scores required for admission.
gre_general.quote: For admission, an applicant must provide transcripts of previous university work, three rating forms or letters of recommendation, and GRE scores (general).

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Earth Sciences / Geology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Upon admission, each student selects a major advisor before entering the Department.
supervisor.quote: Upon admission, each student selects a major advisor before entering the Department.

funding.value: Funding package details not stated on catalog page.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's degree in geosciences or other field required.
entry_route.quote: Prerequisite for either graduate degree is a Bachelor’s degree in the geosciences or other field (typically, but not exclusively, from the physical, natural, or life sciences or engineering).
